name: 同時に一つ選ぶセグメント切替
prompt:
Use case: direct UI image edit for LH07-0025 v006. Image 1 is the exact image supplied by the user. Make only a moderate size adjustment to its existing segmented control.

Preserve the white canvas and keep its current 3:1 composition. Preserve the same exact Japanese labels, three equal segments, center-selected 標準 state, outline, dividers, green gradient, slate text, label weight, and label size. Do not redraw the words, change colors, add effects, or add any other element.

Change only the size of the outer segmented control. In the 2172×724 image, its current bounds are about x=102–1946 and y=215–448. Set the new bounds to about x=271–1901 and y=258–466: roughly 75% of canvas width and 29% of its height. This is a modest reduction from the current large control, and remains clearly larger than the compact version. Keep the text glyphs at their current visual size so each segment retains comfortable space around its label. Re-center the control exactly. Preserve the original proportions of its three cells and the inset selected middle cell.

The control must occupy clearly more than half the image width and more than one quarter of its height. Do not make it a narrow or short strip. Keep the overall image clean, flat, and crisp.
reviewNotes: Candidate-only v006. Visually reviewed at display size against the exact user-attached v001 and Japanese component preview. The control is now about 70% of canvas width and 30% of height, between the too-large v001 and too-compact v003-v005. Three equal options, exact labels, center 標準 selected, readable typography, restrained border and forest-green fill. No owner approval, native editability, application implementation, or runtime acceptance claimed.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.observations: SHA-256 equals the exact user attachment. Preserve its wording and visual treatment; change only overall control bounds.
